title: Quantity hunt
offscreen: When you lay the table, ask: "Can you bring three spoons?". Count together, touching each thing only once.

items.label: One book
items.say: Look for a book and bring it here. Just one.

items.label: Two spoons
items.say: Now two spoons. Count them as you pick them up.

items.label: Three socks
items.say: And now three socks. One, two, three.

items.label: Four socks
items.say: Look for four socks. Count them by touching them.

items.label: Two shoes that make a pair
items.say: Now two shoes that make a pair.

items.label: Five toys
items.say: And five toys. Put them in a row and count them.

intro.bo: {nome}, shall we go on a treasure hunt? You look in your own time, one thing at a time.
intro.pilu: {nome}, I'll tell you something to look for. Look carefully around you: treasures are everywhere.
intro.tango: Treasure hunt, {nome}! I'm coming too! ...No, I'll stay here. You look, slowly.

outro.bo: So many treasures, {nome}. Now each one goes back in its place, so we can find them again tomorrow.
outro.pilu: Every treasure goes back where you found it, {nome}: that's part of the game too.
outro.tango: What a hunt! {nome}, shall we put everything back? I'll... I'll keep an eye on it.
